title: वधूशिक्षामा छचल्किएको समाजपरक दृष्टि Badhushikshyama Chachalkiyeko Samajparak Drishti
nepali: भानुभक्त आचार्य प्राथमिककालीन नेपाली साहित्यका सर्वाधिक चर्चित अनि विशिष्ट व्यक्ति हुन् ।माध्यमिककालीन कवि मोतीराम भट्टद्वारा ‘भानुभक्तको जीवन चरित्र’ नामक कृतिका माध्यमबाटभानुभक्तको जीवनी, व्यक्तित्व र कृतित्वका विषयमा प्रकाश पारिएपछि उनको साहित्यिक व्यक्तित्वअझ प्रस्ट हुन गएको हो । मोतीराम, देवकोटाप्रभृति धेरै कविहरूले पनि प्राथमिककालीन अन्यकविहरूका तुलनामा भानुभक्तका कृतिहरू गुणात्मक रूपमा सबल÷उच्च रहेको भन्ने साहित्यिकदृष्टिकोण प्रकट गरेका छन् । यसै पृष्ठभूमिमा भानु नै आदिकवि थिए भन्ने विषयमा पुष्टि भएकोछ । मूलतः प्रस्तुत आलेखमा ‘वधूशिक्षा’ (१९१९) कृतिमा निहित सामाजिक पक्षको चर्चासहित यसकोसंरचनागत पृष्ठभूमि तथा विषयवस्तुगत भावमाथि प्रकाश पारिएको छ ।
american_english: Bhanubhakta Acharya is the most celebrated and distinguished figure of early-period Nepali literature. After the secondary-period poet Motiram Bhatta shed light on Bhanubhakta's life, character, and literary output through the work titled 'Bhanubhaktako Jiwan Charitra', his literary stature became even clearer. Many poets, including Motiram and Devkota, have also voiced the literary perspective that Bhanubhakta's works are qualitatively robust and superior compared to those of other early-period poets. Against this backdrop, the proposition that Bhanu was indeed the First Poet (Adikavi) has been substantiated. Primarily, this article sheds light on the structural background and thematic substance of the work 'Badhushikshya' (1919 [BS]), along with a discussion of its inherent social dimensions.
british_english: Bhanubhakta Acharya is the most renowned and eminent figure of early-period Nepali literature. Once the secondary-period poet Motiram Bhatta illuminated Bhanubhakta's biography, character and literary oeuvre through the work entitled 'Bhanubhaktako Jiwan Charitra', his literary standing became all the more apparent. Numerous poets, notably Motiram and Devkota, have likewise expressed the literary judgement that Bhanubhakta's works are qualitatively sounder and superior to those of other poets of the early period. Against this background, the premise that Bhanu was indeed the First Poet (Adikavi) has been confirmed. Fundamentally, the present article illuminates the structural context and thematic essence of the work 'Badhushikshya' (1919 [BS]), alongside an examination of the social dimension contained within it.
australian_english: Bhanubhakta Acharya is the most widely known and notable figure of early-period Nepali literature. After the middle-period poet Motiram Bhatta threw light on Bhanubhakta's life story, personality and works through the book titled 'Bhanubhaktako Jiwan Charitra', his literary reputation became clearer still. Plenty of poets, like Motiram and Devkota, have also put forward the literary view that Bhanubhakta's works are qualitatively stronger and higher than those of other poets from the early period. Against that background, the claim that Bhanu was truly the First Poet (Adikavi) has been borne out. Mainly, this paper highlights the structural background and thematic feel of the work 'Badhushikshya' (1919 [BS]), along with a yarn about the social side wrapped up in it.
informal_english: Bhanubhakta Acharya is the most famous and standout figure in early Nepali literature, nae doubt about it. Once the middle-period poet Motiram Bhatta shone a light on Bhanubhakta's life, character, and writings through that work of his, 'Bhanubhaktako Jiwan Charitra', the man's literary standing became clear as day. A fair wheen o' poets, including Motiram and Devkota, have also said that Bhanubhakta's writings are far sturdier and higher in quality than what the other early poets were turning out. It's against that very backdrop that the idea o' Bhanu being the true Adikavi, or First Poet, was properly settled. In the main, this article sheds light on the structural background and thematic feel o' the work 'Badhushikshya' (1919 [BS]), along wi' a good blether about the social side tucked inside it.
